summary: Backend testing completed for 3 Job OS fixes: (1) Same vendor consolidation across ALL MOs, (2) Send DC with skip_stock_deduct=true, (3) DC updates job_work_parts sent_quantity and dc_created. All 24 tests passed.
seed_data_creation: Test data created dynamically with TEST_ prefix for items (RM, FG), suppliers, routings, BOMs, production orders, work orders, SC orders, and DCs
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 Job OS fixes verified working correctly: (1) Consolidation: Outsourcing operations on different MOs to same supplier consolidates into single SC order with both items in job_work_parts and both WO IDs in reference_wo_ids. (2) Send DC: POST /api/job-work/challans with skip_stock_deduct=true works correctly for Job OS. (3) DC updates: job_work_parts.sent_quantity updated and dc_created=true set on SC order. Regression: SC with RM flow still works - stock deducted correctly when skip_stock_deduct is not set.

fix_1_same_vendor_consolidation.details: Outsourcing op on MO-A to Supplier X creates SC. Outsourcing op on MO-B to SAME Supplier X consolidates into SAME SC. job_work_parts contains both items, reference_wo_ids contains both WO IDs. Outsourcing to different supplier creates separate SC.

fix_2_send_dc_skip_stock_deduct.details: POST /api/job-work/challans with skip_stock_deduct=true works correctly. Stock is NOT deducted for Job OS items (parts go for processing, not consumed).

fix_3_dc_updates_job_work_parts.details: DC creation updates job_work_parts.sent_quantity to match quantity sent. dc_created=true is set on SC order after DC creation.

regression_sc_with_rm.details: SC with RM flow still works correctly. Stock is deducted when skip_stock_deduct is not set.
